items.title: Apple TV’s 5-Season Sci-Fi Spectacle Delivers a Masterclass in Worldbuilding
items.summary: When watching science fiction, feeling immersed in the story's universe goes a long way in getting the viewer to like it — if you feel like you're part of that world, you'll never forget it. That's the power of worldbuilding , the narrative process through which storytellers create the settings of their stories, from the environment to its "rules." And, right now, there is no better sci-fi work to properly understand worldbuilding than Apple TV 's For All Mankind . It's set right here, on Earth, over a timeframe that comprises most of our lifetimes, but in a completely different timeline. While everything is familiar enough for the viewer to feel "at home," its world is wildly imaginative in how it's built, making this series a true masterclass in this subject.
items.t: Apple TV’s 5-Season Sci-Fi Spectacle Delivers a Masterclass in Worldbuilding

items.title: ‘Dexter: Resurrection’ Officially Loses Its Streaming Crown to a 20-Year-Old Rival
items.summary: The last few years have been a roller coaster of a ride for Dexter fans, who are now left with only one new show from the franchise. When Dexter exploded on Netflix a few years back, it prompted Paramount to bring the franchise back with various spin-offs, including the well-liked Dexter: Original Sin (starring Patrick Gibson ). Paramount originally decided to renew the show for a second season before later going back and deciding that the series would be canceled after only one season before production on Season 2 was set to begin. There was also going to be another Dexter prequel show about a young Trinity Killer, which would have featured John Lithgow in a voice role, but the series was scrapped before it ever made it off the ground. This leaves only one Dexter show left standing — Dexter: Resurrection .
items.t: ‘Dexter: Resurrection’ Officially Loses Its Streaming Crown to a 20-Year-Old Rival

items.title: David O. Russell’s ‘Madden’ Biopic Is Out Next Week — Does Anybody Know or Care?
items.summary: Amazon MGM Studios' release strategy for the five-time Oscar nominee's forthcoming "Madden," starring Nicolas Cage in a fat suit and hairpiece, suggests a classic case of bag-and-tag.
items.t: David O. Russell’s ‘Madden’ Biopic Is Out Next Week — Does Anybody Know or Care?

items.title: In Shana Feste’s Films, Gender-Flipping Cinema’s ‘Tradition of Celebrating Damaged Men’ Is Its Own Reward
items.summary: Her Jessica Chastain-starring Netflix drama "Heartland" is the latest entry in Feste's distinct canon. It's a space where, she tells IndieWire, women aren't "unlikable," they're just more nuanced, more complicated, and way more able to get shit done.
items.t: In Shana Feste’s Films, Gender-Flipping Cinema’s ‘Tradition of Celebrating Damaged Men’ Is Its Own Reward

items.title: ’12 12 12′ Review: Anthony Mackie and Jamie Dornan’s Ticking-Clock Heist Thriller Runs on Broken Time
items.summary: An FBI agent out for revenge. A thief planning one last score. You know the story, but in Dudi Appleton and Jim Keeble's convoluted Apple series, you can watch it unfold across three non-chronological timelines.
items.t: ’12 12 12′ Review: Anthony Mackie and Jamie Dornan’s Ticking-Clock Heist Thriller Runs on Broken Time

items.title: Jensen Huang’s Biopic Feels Inevitable — The Right One Might Be Impossible
items.summary: After "The Social Reckoning" stumbled at the box office and voter backlash over data centers dovetailed with awards buzz for "Artificial," any film about the former Nvidia exec would have to keep pace with a tech industry that’s changing by the day.
items.t: Jensen Huang’s Biopic Feels Inevitable — The Right One Might Be Impossible

items.title: Miles Teller Opens Up About ‘Paper Tiger,’ Adam Driver, and Losing His Home Before Filming James Gray’s Movie
items.summary: In James Gray's Cannes hit about two brothers falling out with the Russian mafia, Teller plays against type as a sensitive family man opposite Adam Driver and Scarlett Johansson.
items.t: Miles Teller Opens Up About ‘Paper Tiger,’ Adam Driver, and Losing His Home Before Filming James Gray’s Movie

items.title: ‘The Good Daughter’ Review: Rose Byrne Sizzles in Peacock’s Brutal Trauma-Drama About Crime-Solving Sisters
items.summary: The clichés stack up nearly as fast as the clever cast can distinguish them in Karin Slaughter's six-episode adaptation of her own book, which follows long-separated sisters who reunite to defend a young woman from the predators lurking in their brutish, backwoods hometown.
items.t: ‘The Good Daughter’ Review: Rose Byrne Sizzles in Peacock’s Brutal Trauma-Drama About Crime-Solving Sisters
